title: Two Drunk Grown Men Act Like Children After Disrespecting Female Bartender
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 23rd, 2023. Officers were called to a local bar in reference to two drunk men who refused to leave after causing a disturbance. When officers arrived on the scene the two men continued to be argumentative and refused to listen to simple commands. This is the body-cam footage of the following events.
